name: Trajectory Assist
description: Predicts your player's path and delays clicks that would be too early.

show-trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Draw the predicted path. Grey = no click, green = click now.

autocorrect.name: Autocorrect Early Clicks
autocorrect.description: If clicking right now would kill you but clicking a few ticks later wouldn't, delay the click until the safe tick.

safe-mode.name: Auto Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: When autocorrect is used, stop the level from saving progress or submitting completions until you leave the level.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
practice-only.description: Only autocorrect in practice mode, so it can't affect normal runs or leaderboard attempts.

predict-ticks.name: Prediction Length (ticks)
predict-ticks.description: How far ahead to simulate. 240 ticks = 1 second.

max-delay.name: Max Correction Delay (ticks)
max-delay.description: Largest delay autocorrect may add to a click. 12 ticks = 50ms.

hold-ticks.name: Assumed Hold Length (ticks)
hold-ticks.description: How long the simulation assumes you hold the click before releasing.
